notes.title: New cloak, who dis?
notes.content:
Enjoyed Shelter from the Storm? Why not support the developer and get a colourful cloak to boot!

The new DLC includes:

[list]
[*] Snazzy orange cloak
[*] Eternal gratitude of a struggling indie dev
[*] It's purely cosmetic (but the enemies will have a higher level of respect for you)
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has left a positive review, reading them brings me big joy.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.content:
A small update to fix the light drizzle of bugs found since launch:

[list]
[*] Chalk and sheet music could reappear after you'd used them
[*] Intermittent problem moving between rooms in the library
[/list]
Thanks go to DrigglyEast for reporting them ːsteamthumbsupː
